name: Initialized Parameter
hint: A named parameter passes a value into a custom block and makes its behaviour adaptable.
instruction: Add the parameter to the block definition and use it in the block body where the supplied value should take effect.

examples.label: Example
examples.scratchblocks:
define jump [height]
forever
if <key (up arrow v) pressed?> then
glide (1) secs to x: (0) y: (height)
glide (1) secs to x: (0) y: (0)
end
end
